note_en: Round 3 continues with two 0-2 elimination Bo3s and two 1-1 Bo1s. TES and IG moved to 2-1. GEN–LYON and DK–MKOI were still in progress when this was built. The model is 1/1 on settled calls (TES 1-0 G2, exact). For entertainment only.
note_zh: 第三轮继续：两场 0-2 淘汰 Bo3 与两场 1-1 Bo1。TES、IG 升至 2-1。GEN–LYON、DK–MKOI 在数据生成时仍在进行。已结算预测 1/1 命中（TES 1-0 G2，比分精确）。仅供娱乐。

series.reason_en: Elimination Bo3 between two 0-2 sides. The model and Polymarket (72.5%) both favour AL; no roster news changes the read.
series.reason_zh: 两支 0-2 队伍的淘汰 Bo3。模型与 Polymarket（72.5%）都看好 AL，暂无影响判断的阵容消息。
factors_en: Fearless: both pools sit at depth 30; AL's Nocturne (89% presence, 78% win rate) will likely be banned or burned early.
Market prices AL at 72.5% versus the model's 67.1%, so the blend leans away from TL.
Both teams are 0-2, so the loser is out of Worlds.
factors_zh: 无畏征召：双方英雄池深度均为 30；AL 的梦魇登场率 89%、胜率 78%，大概率被早禁或早用。
市场给 AL 72.5%，高于模型 67.1%，融合后更偏离 TL。

series.reason_en: Another 0-2 elimination Bo3. TSW is favoured at 63% (market 65.5%), with a 0-2 sweep the single most likely scoreline.
series.reason_zh: 又一场 0-2 淘汰 Bo3。TSW 胜率 63%（市场 65.5%），最可能比分为 0-2。
factors_en: Fearless: TSW has shown Ezreal, Qiyana and Rumble, all top-12 meta picks, giving it more flex options in games 2-3.
LOS's played pool leans on Syndra, Nocturne and Orianna, which are heavily contested and often banned.
The market (65.5%) and the model (63%) agree within three points.
factors_zh: 无畏征召：TSW 已用过伊泽瑞尔、奇亚娜、兰博等 meta 前 12 英雄，第二、三局可选面更宽。
LOS 已用英雄集中在辛德拉、梦魇、奥莉安娜，均为高争夺、常被禁用的位置。
市场 65.5% 与模型 63% 相差不足 3 个百分点。

series.reason_en: Bo1 at 1-1. The model has T1 at 75.6%; the market is more confident at 88.5%. One game means high variance.
series.reason_zh: 1-1 组的 Bo1。模型给 T1 75.6%，市场更乐观（88.5%）。单局定胜负，波动大。
factors_en: Fearless: in a Bo1 nothing carries over, so T1's depth of 29 versus CFO's 30 matters little; only bans shape the draft.
Vi, which T1 has played, has 91% presence but a 25% win rate. Whether T1 picks it again is a draft tell.
Market and model differ by 13 points, the widest gap among today's open series.
factors_zh: 无畏征召：Bo1 不存在跨局消耗，T1 深度 29 与 CFO 30 差异不大，仅禁用影响选人。
T1 用过的蔚登场率 91% 但胜率仅 25%，是否再拿是征召看点。
市场与模型相差 13 个百分点，为今日未开赛场次中分歧最大。

series.reason_en: Bo1 at 1-1. BLG is favoured at 71.7%, and the market (70.5%) almost exactly agrees.
series.reason_zh: 1-1 组的 Bo1。BLG 胜率 71.7%，市场 70.5%，几乎一致。
factors_en: Fearless: KC has the shallowest pool at the event (depth 28) and leans on Kalista/Renata and Cassiopeia.
BLG's played pool (Akali, Orianna, Lee Sin, Nautilus) overlaps with high-presence meta picks.
Model and market are within 1.2 points, so the line is stable.
factors_zh: 无畏征召：KC 英雄池深度 28，全场最浅，依赖卡莉丝塔/芮娜塔与卡西奥佩娅。
BLG 已用阿卡丽、奥莉安娜、李青、诺提勒斯，与高登场率 meta 重合。
模型与市场相差仅 1.2 个百分点，盘面稳定。

champion.reason_en: 2-0 in Swiss and in its Round 3 Bo3 against LYON at build time; the model (46.2%) is above the market (37.7%).
champion.reason_zh: 瑞士轮 2-0，生成数据时正与 LYON 进行第三轮 Bo3；模型 46.2% 高于市场 37.7%。

champion.reason_en: 1-1 with a Bo1 against KC next; the model gives 16.1% versus the market's 11%.
champion.reason_zh: 1-1，下一场 Bo1 对 KC；模型 16.1%，市场 11%。

champion.reason_en: Beat G2 1-0 to reach 2-1; the model's 12.5% is far above the market's 1.3%, a gap worth noting.
champion.reason_zh: 1-0 击败 G2 升至 2-1；模型 12.5% 远高于市场 1.3%，分歧值得关注。

champion.reason_en: 2-0 with the deepest Fearless pool (35); model 11.9% and market 12.1% nearly agree.
champion.reason_zh: 2-0，无畏征召英雄池最深（35）；模型 11.9% 与市场 12.1% 几乎一致。

champion.reason_en: 1-1; the model has only 2.6% against the market's 16.2%, the largest under-model gap.
champion.reason_zh: 1-1；模型仅 2.6%，市场 16.2%，为模型低于市场最多的队伍。

mvp.basis_en: Tops the MVP board at 24.1%, driven by GEN's 46.2% title odds.
mvp.basis_zh: 以 24.1% 居 MVP 榜首，源于 GEN 46.2% 的夺冠概率。

mvp.basis_en: 21.4%: GEN's jungler, sharing in the team's title odds.
mvp.basis_zh: 21.4%，GEN 打野，分享队伍夺冠概率。

mvp.basis_en: 21.0%: nearly level with Canyon among GEN's core.
mvp.basis_zh: 21.0%，与 Canyon 并列 GEN 核心。

mvp.basis_en: 11.6%: the top non-GEN candidate, tied to BLG's 16.1% title odds.
mvp.basis_zh: 11.6%，非 GEN 选手中最高，对应 BLG 16.1% 夺冠概率。

mvp.basis_en: 8.5%: TES mid, who started in the 1-0 win over G2.
mvp.basis_zh: 8.5%，TES 中单，1-0 击败 G2 一役首发。

fearless.note_en: Depth 35 is joint-highest; it has shown Vi, Syndra and Cassiopeia, three of the top-4 presence picks.
fearless.note_zh: 深度 35 并列最高，已用蔚、辛德拉、卡西奥佩娅三个登场率前四英雄。

fearless.note_en: Depth 35 is joint-highest, though Kalista, Renata, Olaf, Xin Zhao and Ahri were consumed against GEN.
fearless.note_zh: 深度 35 并列最高，但对 GEN 一役已消耗卡莉丝塔、芮娜塔、奥拉夫、赵信、阿狸。

fearless.note_en: Depth 34, and it won its Bo1 against HLE on Yunara/Lulu/Nocturne/Annie/Kled.
fearless.note_zh: 深度 34，以云娜拉/璐璐/梦魇/安妮/克烈 Bo1 击败 HLE。

fearless.note_en: Depth 28 is the shallowest in the field, a risk in any later Bo3.
fearless.note_zh: 深度 28 全场最浅，后续若进 Bo3 存在风险。
